code='''def transform(grid):
    # The grid is a regular array of panels separated by solid separator lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        row = []
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            tile = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            # Mark panels containing exactly two anomalous cells.
            counts = {}
            for v in tile:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
            bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            anomaly_count = sum(n for v, n in counts.items() if v != bg)
            row.append(1 if anomaly_count == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
